none: PAS NLM-55F876: Roman Coin: Barbarous Radiate
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Possibly Barbarous Radiate issue of 275-285, Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate head cuirassed right, possibly beardless and based on Tetricus II (272-274). Obverse inscription: IMP[---]. Reverse description: Female figure standing right with both arms held away from sides. Blundered legend. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 2.09gms, die axis: 4
